thread:
incidents-bot: [ALERT] realtime-api (prod) p99 latency 3.4s > SLO 2.0s — us-west-2 — paging oncall @raj — severity: page :rotating_light:

emily.k: noticed a jump ~09:10 UTC, some client 504s reported. tagging oncall.

raj: I'm oncall, joining. quick checks: dashboards, recent deploys, node restarts. anyone seen deploy around 09:05?

sara: no deploys. looking at kvcache metrics — hit rate dropped from 98% -> ~60% at 09:09, eviction rate spiked.

mike: checking routing and autoscaler events now. no recent route changes, autoscaler shows CPU spike on gpu-pool-3 at 09:08.

raj: running quick datadog query to split by shard and model:
```
avg:p99_latency{service:realtime-api,env:prod} by {shard,model} rollup(60)
```
results show p99 concentrated on shard-7 serving long-context models.

emily.k: ops reported a customer-facing ticket INC-1234 (enterprise) with intermittent 504s and stretched response times. escalate if impact widens.

ops-bot: Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/latency-spike — suggested mitigations: 1) route-shift 2) reduce batch window 3) check kv-cache master node.

raj: Sara, can you check kv-master-01 memory pressure + eviction logs? Mike, can you run a quick curl to shard-7 to reproduce and capture headers? I'll open a bridge if we need live hands.

sara: grabbing logs. tail shows repeated `evict_key` storms after a GC cycle on kv-master-01 around 09:07. probable cache invalidation cascade.

mike: curl to shard-7: `curl -s -D - -o /dev/null "https://api.redwood/prod/realtime?shard=7"` — getting 500s and ~3.2s TTFB, headers show upstream timeout 15s is untouched.

raj: mitigation plan: 1) mark shard-7 as degraded and route-shift to shard-3/4 for new requests, 2) reduce batching window to 20ms for affected pool, 3) restart kv-master-01 after snapshot to avoid another eviction storm. I'll implement route-shift first to prevent more client impact.

emily.k: I'll notify CS and customers impacted, tag incident. turning on increased log retention for traces.

mike: route-shift in progress via control-plane: `rpctl route shift --from shard-7 --to shard-3,shard-4 --dry-run=false` — starting now.

sara: snapshot completed, prepping graceful restart of kv-master-01. eviction rate dropping after routing change, cache hit trending up.

raj: restarting kv-master-01 (graceful). pods will resync; monitoring p99.

incidents-bot: Note: p99 alert suppressed for shard-7 during route-shift (auto-fallback enabled).

mike: after route-shift + kv restart: p99 realtime-api now 1.7s, p95 0.45s. some traces still warming but customer 504s have fallen to baseline.

emily.k: great. recording customer-impact window 09:07–09:22 UTC. forwarding details to CS + postmortem queue.

raj: marking initial triage complete. assigning to eng-runtime (sara + mike) for follow-up: root-cause (kv eviction cascade), and to infra for autoscaler review. I'll file an incident ticket and schedule a short postmortem.

ops-bot: Incident ticket created: INC-2026-489 — assigned to eng-runtime. Runbook step: consider kvcache tuning to avoid full-key invalidation on GC.

emily.k: thanks team — closing monitoring loop. :thumbsup:

incidents-bot: [RESOLVED] realtime-api p99 back within SLO (auto-resolve) — incident status: monitoring.
